claims.text: The Sungai Liang Cracker operated by Coral Bay Olefins in Brunei is the only ethylene plant in Southeast Asia for which nameplate capacity is not publicly confirmed.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.

claims.text: Coral Bay Olefins has explicitly stated it does not disclose the nameplate capacity of the Sungai Liang ethane cracker.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.

claims.text: The ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor does not publish estimates for units where the operator has not disclosed nameplate capacity, including the Sungai Liang Cracker.

citations.quote: The Monitor does not publish estimates for units where the operator has not disclosed nameplate capacity.

claims.text: The Regional Energy Statistics Office does not publish producer-level petrochemical capacity figures and its naphtha note contains no plant-level capacity data.

citations.quote: It does not contain plant-level petrochemical capacity data, and the Office does not publish producer-level capacity figures.

claims.text: The ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its overview bulletin; it only lists units individually in its capacity database.

citations.quote: The Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in this bulletin.

claims.text: Nusantara Olefins has begun pre-FEED work for a potential second steam cracker at Cilegon, but no capacity, feedstock configuration, or schedule has been fixed and no investment decision has been taken.

citations.quote: The company said no investment decision has been taken and no capacity, feedstock configuration or schedule has been fixed.

gaps.subject: Sungai Liang Cracker (Coral Bay Olefins) ethylene capacity
gaps.detail: No nameplate capacity figure is disclosed for the Sungai Liang Cracker; operator and industry sources confirm this gap.

citations.quote: The company said it does not disclose nameplate capacity for the cracker.
The Monitor does not publish estimates for units where the operator has not disclosed nameplate capacity.

gaps.subject: Aggregate regional ethylene capacity totals
gaps.detail: The ASEAN Petrochemical Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in its overview bulletin; only individual unit listings are available.

citations.quote: The Monitor does not publish aggregate regional capacity totals in this bulletin.

gaps.subject: Producer-level petrochemical capacity figures
gaps.detail: The Regional Energy Statistics Office does not publish producer-level capacity figures and its naphtha note contains no plant-level capacity data.

citations.quote: It does not contain plant-level petrochemical capacity data, and the Office does not publish producer-level capacity figures.

gaps.subject: Cilegon Cracker 2 (Nusantara Olefins)
gaps.detail: No capacity, feedstock configuration, or schedule is fixed for the proposed second Cilegon cracker; no investment decision has been taken.

citations.quote: The company said no investment decision has been taken and no capacity, feedstock configuration or schedule has been fixed.

coverage_note: The main gap in the regional ethylene capacity base is the absence of a publicly confirmed figure for the Sungai Liang Cracker in Brunei. Other gaps include the lack of aggregate regional capacity totals and producer-level figures in some official sources. Proposed projects without fixed capacity or schedule are also not included in the confirmed base.
